note: PSL(2,7) acts 2-transitively on the 8 points of P^1(F_7); the 56 ordered pairs have a C3 stabilizer conjugate to a Sylow 3, so they are isomorphic as PSL-sets to the 56 elements of order 3. The 8 points and the 8 Sylow 7-subgroups both have stabilizer order 21. The 21 Sylow 2-subgroups match the 21 Fano flags. The 42 order-4 elements and the 42 ordered Fano pairs have the same size only: the ordered-pair stabilizer is V4 while the centralizer of an order-4 element is C4, so they are not isomorphic as PSL-sets.
